name: capicua transcriptional repressor
pathways: regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II

function.text: CIC encodes protein capicua homolog. Annotated molecular activities include DNA-binding transcription factor activity, RNA polymerase II-specific and RNA polymerase II transcription regulatory region sequence-specific DNA binding. It participates in negative regulation of DNA-templated transcription and regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to complex neurodevelopmental disorder (autosomal dominant); intellectual developmental disorder, autosomal dominant 45 (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include CIC-rearranged sarcoma; CNS CIC-rearranged sarcoma; Oligodendroglioma, IDH-mutant and 1p/19q-codeleted. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.
